about_the_game:
▶ Explore Multiversal Worlds

Journey across diverse, visually distinct dimensions, each with its own challenges and lore:

Cybernetic Metropolis – A city of runaway tech and digital gods. “The more advanced the civilization, the harder it crashes.”

Shadow-Eclipsed Forest – A twisted realm where even shadows come alive. “The trees whisper, and the dark bites back.”

Wasteland Ruins – A chaotic battlefield where ancient power meets shattered tech. “Equations etched into stone, left unsolved forever.”

...and more.

▶ Epic Boss Fights & Branching Endings

Face off against the Dimension Reaper, Kaos, a villain who manipulates rifts to devour entire worlds.

Multi-phase Boss Battles – Kaos summons echoes of fallen worlds and uses powerful skills like rift teleportation and energy siphoning.

Moral Choices, Multiple Endings – After defeating Kaos, your final decision—to destroy or preserve the energy core—will shape the fate of all worlds: will you revive the multiverse, seize power, or trap reality in an endless loop?

▶ Play Your Way

Choose from a variety of characters, each a unique force that bends the rules of reality.

“These aren’t classes—they’re variables in a system on the brink.”

▶ Customize Your Journey

Gear System – Collect fragments of energy cores from different worlds to craft powerful new equipment.

Weapon Crafting – Build weapons using parts dropped by enemies across dimensions.

Companion System – Tap into the shattered power of broken altars to forge your ultimate support allies.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10,Windows11
  • Processor: AMD RX2600,Inter Core 2.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM / DirectX 11+ support
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10,Windows11
  • Processor: AMD RX5600，Inter Core 3.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM / DirectX 11+ support
  • DirectX: Version 11
